def main():
  assert TICI, "unsupported hardware for pigeond"

  # register exit handler
  pigeon = None
  signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, lambda sig, frame: deinitialize_and_exit(pigeon))

  pm = messaging.PubMaster(['ubloxRaw'])

  # power cycle ublox
  set_power(False)
  time.sleep(0.1)
  set_power(True)
  time.sleep(0.5)

  pigeon = TTYPigeon()
  initialize_pigeon(pigeon)

  # start receiving data
  while True:
    dat = pigeon.receive()
    if len(dat) > 0:
      if dat[0] == 0x00:
        cloudlog.warning("received invalid data from ublox, re-initing!")
        initialize_pigeon(pigeon)
        continue

      # send out to socket
      msg = messaging.new_message('ubloxRaw', len(dat))
      msg.ubloxRaw = dat[:]
      pm.send('ubloxRaw', msg)
    else:
      # prevent locking up a CPU core if ublox disconnects
      time.sleep(0.001)

def main():
  assert TICI, "unsupported hardware for pigeond"

  # register exit handler
  pigeon = None
  signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, lambda sig, frame: deinitialize_and_exit(pigeon))

  pm = messaging.PubMaster(['ubloxRaw'])

  # power cycle ublox
  set_power(False)
  time.sleep(0.1)
  set_power(True)
  time.sleep(0.5)

  pigeon = TTYPigeon()
  r = initialize_pigeon(pigeon)
  Params().put_bool("UbloxAvailable", r)

  # start receiving data
  while True:
    dat = pigeon.receive()
    if len(dat) > 0:
      if dat[0] == 0x00:
        cloudlog.warning("received invalid data from ublox, re-initing!")
        initialize_pigeon(pigeon)
        continue

      # send out to socket
      msg = messaging.new_message('ubloxRaw', len(dat))
      msg.ubloxRaw = dat[:]
      pm.send('ubloxRaw', msg)
    else:
      # prevent locking up a CPU core if ublox disconnects
      time.sleep(0.001)
